recognize_zh: 單核球門控的 FLAER 對 CD14 圖中，箭頭所指的大族群同時 FLAER 陰性與 CD14 陰性（兩者皆為 GPI 錨定），占 94.54%（2,599/2,749），右上方僅少數正常單核球，代表極大的 PNH 克隆。
features: Dot plot of FLAER-FITC (x) versus CD14-PE (y) gated on monocytes
Dominant population (arrow) negative for both FLAER and CD14 within the PNH gate
Small residual normal population at upper right expressing FLAER and CD14
Adequate event count for high-sensitivity analysis
describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plot of FLAER versus CD14, gated on monocytes, shows a dominant population (arrow) lacking both FLAER binding and the GPI-anchored antigen CD14, with only a small residual normal population expressing both markers at the upper right. The PNH gate contains 94.54% of monocytes (2,599 of 2,749 events). Loss of FLAER, which binds the GPI anchor itself, together with a second GPI-linked marker, confirms GPI-anchor deficiency. Findings demonstrate a very large PNH clone in monocytes, consistent with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria; the smaller red cell clone reflects selective hemolysis and transfusion of PNH red cells.

ddx.dx: Isolated CD14 loss in immature or abnormal monocytes (e.g., CMML, AML)
ddx.vs: Monocytic neoplasms may lose CD14 but retain FLAER binding.

ddx.dx: Small PNH clone associated with aplastic anemia
ddx.vs: Clone sizes are usually small (often <10%) rather than more than 90% of monocytes.

ddx.dx: Gating artifact with lymphocyte or debris contamination
ddx.vs: Lymphocytes are CD14-negative but FLAER-positive, so they would fall outside the double-negative PNH gate.
